item.title: iOS 27 Introduces Custom Three‑Band EQ for AirPods
item.description: iOS 27 adds a device‑specific three‑band equalizer for AirPods Pro 2/3, AirPods 4 and AirPods Max 2, syncing settings across iPhone, iPad and Mac.
